$comment: Requests the client makes that the backend does not serve — the D2 defect class
(docs/uplevel/00-audit.md §3). Each entry is an accepted gap, not a fix: the gate
in api-endpoint-contract.test.ts fails on any mismatch that is NOT listed here,
and also fails when an entry below no longer has a client call site, so this list
cannot quietly grow or go stale. Every path was checked against backend route
source, not only against docs/openapi.json. Each `next` names where the gap is
ruled on or repaired: the F2.2 feature inventory row (docs/reference/feature-
inventory.md) or the owning lane's package.
Two entry shapes, matching the two ways D2 shows up. An entry with only `path`
says the route is absent and excuses no verb question; an entry with `method`
says the path IS served but not with that verb, so the client would get 405
where it expects data. The two never cross-match: a path entry cannot shelter a
new wrong-verb call at the same path, and a method entry cannot shelter a missing
path. A `method` entry goes stale when the call with that verb is fixed, even if
the path is still called other ways.
